subject.title: Android: add adaptive app navigation sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this persistent Android sidebar as the new cross-layout navigation model, replacing the current compact bottom-navigation presentation on wide displays?
rationale: This is a broad user-facing Android information-architecture change, not a repair to an established contract; source-level correctness cannot determine whether this is the intended product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the adaptive shell
options.body: Confirm the sidebar direction, request current-head device proof and focused parity review, then continue normal merge review.

options.title: Keep compact navigation
options.body: Decline this product direction and close the PR without treating the implementation quality as a correctness failure.

options.title: Request a narrower experiment
options.body: Ask for a scoped design or issue that defines target devices, navigation parity, and acceptance criteria before reconsidering implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the adaptive shell
recommendation.body: Confirm the sidebar direction, request current-head device proof and focused parity review, then continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only identifiable contributor connected to the proposed Android navigation behavior; an Android product owner was not established from the available history.
